wentWell:
• Tom's CI/CD pipeline was operational from day one — automated builds and deployments gave the whole team confidence immediately
• Emma delivered the design system ahead of schedule with 22 components — provided the entire frontend team with a consistent, reusable foundation
• Raj's JWT authentication API was well-architected and clean — no rework required in subsequent sprints
• Development environments were stable and reproducible from the start thanks to Tom's Infrastructure-as-Code templates
• Good team spirit and collaboration despite it being the first sprint — no blame culture when blockers emerged
improve:
• Two critical blockers from Apex Bank credential delays (MFA OTP + VirusTotal API key) severely impacted sprint velocity — lost nearly a full week of productive development
• No formal escalation path existed for unresolved client dependencies — emails went unanswered for days before the SM escalated
• Sprint planning did not account for the risk of client failing to deliver credentials on time — pre-sprint dependency checklist was absent
• PHX-004 RBAC was underestimated and spilled over — story pointing needs more rigorous breakdown for complex permission systems
• Sprint velocity of 45/80 SP was primarily due to external factors, but the team needs better tooling to flag dependency risk early
recognition:
• Tom Bradley: exceptional environment provisioning and CI/CD setup — the entire team benefited from his groundwork from day one
• Emma Clarke: design system delivered ahead of schedule — 22 components that set the quality bar for the whole project UI
• Sarah Mitchell: maintained productivity and positive attitude while blocked — found alternative tasks rather than waiting
• Raj Patel: clean and well-tested JWT architecture that held up under scrutiny throughout the entire project
actionItems:
Team: Create a pre-sprint client dependency checklist — all required credentials and API access must be confirmed before sprint planning begins
Anand: Escalate unresolved client blockers to Apex Bank PMO within 24 hours of first report, not at end-of-sprint
Sarah Mitchell: Document MFA integration pattern for Sprint 2 handover so no context is lost
